What is Deel?

Deel is a global payroll and HR platform that helps companies hire, manage, pay, and equip any worker, anywhere. It is one platform for payroll, HR, benefits, mobility, performance and device management across 150 countries. Built on owned infrastructure, powered by AI and supported by thousands of local experts, Deel helps businesses scale smarter, faster and more compliantly.

Trusted by 40,000+ customers, Deel handles the complexities of global employment and alleviates compliance concerns when hiring and growing internationally.

At just over seven years old, Deel has surpassed $1.5bn in revenue and has a valuation of $17.3bn.
